sentences.en: I took my cat to the veterinary hospital yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天带猫去了宠物医院。

sentences.en: In the veterinary clinic, the sick dog was put to sleep.
sentences.zh: 在兽医诊所里，那只生病的狗被安乐死了。

sentences.en: Thanks to the marvels of modern veterinary medicine, our pets are living much longer lives.
sentences.zh: 多亏了现代兽医技术的进步，我们的宠物寿命更长了。

senses.zh: (为医治)动物(尤指家禽家畜)疾病的;兽医的
